selection.basis: The fresh queue has zero ready fields but the highest-priority remaining record is the exact LightCarbon SPEEDZ model; its core specifications remain unpopulated, and the prior official 2025-26 PDF fetch timed out. This batch tests one distinct, current official manufacturer web/catalog route rather than repeating the timed-out PDF or prior image checks.

research_route.allowed_route: Current official LightCarbon product/catalog pages other than the previously timed-out 2025-26 Catalog V2 PDF.
research_route.stop_rule: One exact-model route/search only. Stop at the first decisive exact-model source or after the bounded official-domain lookup finds no matching SPEEDZ specification. Do not transfer measurements or parts from another LightCarbon model.
research_route.evidence_capture: Record the exact URL, page/document title, access date, model identity, directly supported fields and any conflicts or limitations. No image inspection, copying, or third-party source search in this batch.

done_criteria: Preserve current unknowns unless the exact SPEEDZ source directly supports a value.
Add dated source provenance and update only exact fields directly supported by evidence.
Record bounded no-result, access block, or conflict as an explicit unresolved result without treating it as proof of nonexistence.
Run focused research validation and the full npm run check once if any data/source/research record changes; docs-only no-result record needs no full gate.
Local B67 batch only; no push, pull request, merge, publication or production action.
delivery: Local B67 batch only; no push, pull request, merge, publication or production action.
